summary_en: The dioceses of England and Wales may insert St Mary Bernard (Bernadette) Soubirous, virgin, in their calendar on 16 April as an optional memorial.

summary_en: The archdiocese of Genoa may insert in its proper calendar Blessed Maria Repetto, virgin, on 5 January as an obligatory memorial and Blessed Luigi Orione, priest, on 12 March as an optional memorial.

summary_en: In the calendar of the Church of Lucca the celebration of St Bruno, priest, may be transferred from 6 October to 5 October, kept as an optional memorial.

summary_en: The dioceses of Norway may insert some celebrations of Saints (not named in the Summarium) in the proper calendar of Norway with the grade of obligatory memorial.

summary_en: The diocese of Saint-Flour may insert the celebration of St Dismas, the Good Thief (Sanctus Bonus Latro), in its diocesan calendar on 12 October as an optional memorial.

summary_en: In the dioceses of the Chinese Regional Bishops' Conference the solemnity of St Joseph, principal patron, may be transferred from 10 October to 19 March, the day on which it is inscribed in the General Roman Calendar (nation left null: the conference is the Chinese Regional Bishops' Conference seated in Taiwan).

summary_en: The election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title « Nossa Senhora das Graças » as patroness of the city and of St Benedict, abbot, as patron of the diocese of Bragança is confirmed (nation left null: bare « Brigantiensis » may be Bragança Paulista, Brazil, or Bragança, Portugal).

summary_en: The diocese of Chartres may insert in its calendar the memorial of Blessed François de Laval on 6 May and the memorial of All Saints of the diocese of Chartres on 8 November.

celebration.name_latin: Beati Alphonsus de Baena et Ioannes a Sancto Martino Rodriguez

summary_en: The archdiocese of Toledo may insert the celebration of Blessed Alfonso de Baena and Blessed Juan de San Martín Rodríguez in its calendar on 14 July as an optional memorial; in their birthplaces (« Villatobas » and « Yuncos ») it is kept on 15 July as an obligatory memorial, and there the obligatory memorial of St Bonaventure is transferred from 15 to 17 July.
excerpt:
Toletana, 15 martii 1982 (Prot. CD 369/82): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Alphonsi de Baena et Beati Ioannis a Sancto Martino Rodriguez in Calendarium archidioecesis Toletanae inseri valeat, quotannis die 14 iulii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.
Conceditur insuper ut in locis nativitatis Beatorum, scilicet: « Villatobas » et « Yuncos », eorundem celebratio die 15 iulii gradu memoriae obligatoriae peragi valeat. In supradictis locis celebratio memoriae obligatoriae Sancti Bonaventurae, episcopi et Ecclesiae Doctoris, a die 15 ad diem 17 iulii transferatur.

summary_en: In the diocese of Córdoba (Spain) the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary « Santísima Virgen del Castillo » as principal patroness and of St Anne as secondary patroness before God of the town of « Carcabuey » is confirmed.

The Society of the Divine Saviour (Salvatorians) may insert the liturgical celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary Mother of the Saviour in its calendar on 11 October with the grade of solemnity.
excerpt: Societas Divini Salvatoris, 18 octobris 1982 (Prot. CD 213/82): conceditur ut celebratio liturgica Beatae Mariae Virginis Matris Salvatoris in Calendarium Societatis inseri valeat, quotannis die 11 octobris gradu sollemnitatis peragenda.

summary_en: In the diocese of Mantua the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary of the Rosary as patroness before God of the parish community of « Guidizzolo » is confirmed.
excerpt: Mantuana, 23 septembris 1982 (Prot. CD 942/82): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis a Rosario Patronae apud Deum communitatis paroecialis loci v.d. « Guidizzolo ».

summary_en: In the archdiocese of Mariana (Brazil) the election of St Rita of Cascia as patroness before God of the town and whole municipality of « Viçosa » is confirmed.
excerpt: Marianensis, 28 octobris 1982 (Prot. CD 947/82): confirmatur electio Sanctae Ritae de Cascia Patronae apud Deum oppidi totiusque municipii v.d. « Viçosa ».

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Teresia a Iesu Jornet Ibars

summary_en: The election of St Teresa of Jesus Jornet Ibars as patroness before God of the elderly of Puerto Rico is confirmed — a patron of a category of persons, not of a territory; recorded for review.
excerpt: Portoricus, 9 augusti 1982 (Prot. CD 825/82): confirmatur electio Sanctae Teresiae a Iesu Jornet Ibars Patronae apud Deum senum Portorici.

summary_en: Not a decree: the report of the US Bishops' Committee on the Liturgy (meeting of 15 June 1982) records the Committee's recommendation to add Blessed André Bessette and Blessed Marie-Rose Durocher to the Proper Calendar for the Dioceses of the USA and to transfer the memorial of Blessed Kateri Tekakwitha from 17 April to another date; the NCCB was to vote on « three requested changes/additions to the Proper Calendar » in November 1982. Recorded for review as a pending national-calendar change without protocol or Congregation act.
excerpt: Acting on a number of requests sent to the Committee, the members decided to recommend the addition of Blessed André Bessette and Blessed Marie-Rose Durocher to the Proper Calendar for the Dioceses of the USA; and the transfer of the memorial of Blessed Kateri Tekakwitha from April 17 to another more suitable date.
